summary: Build supplier risk assessment, mitigation, and resilience skills in 5 days. Learn ISO 31000, SCOR, dashboards, and reporting tools.
lede: Supplier risk and resilience management helps procurement and supply chain professionals assess supplier exposure and plan actions to support critical flows. The course covers risk registers and scoring, critical-supplier segmentation, and mitigation through diversification, contingency sourcing, and continuity planning. It also develops early-warning monitoring and resilience reporting using supplier performance, compliance, and risk indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage supplier exposure, continuity, and compliance across procurement and supply chain operations.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with supplier management, procurement, logistics, or supply chain reporting. A laptop is required for worksheet and dashboard exercises, and access to your own supplier examples is helpful if you want to tailor the tools during class.
